questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the 'Show Me' panel in Tableau?

options.text: To suggest and quickly build appropriate chart types based on selected fields
To connect to a new data source

questions.question: In Tableau, what is a 'Sheet'?

options.text: A single worksheet where a visualization is built

questions.question: What does dragging a field onto the 'Rows' shelf in Tableau typically do?

options.text: Defines what appears along the vertical axis or as row headers
Deletes the field from the data source

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'Marks' card in Tableau?

options.text: To control how data points are visually encoded, such as color, size, and shape

questions.question: What is a Tableau 'Dashboard'?

options.text: A combination of multiple worksheets and objects arranged on one canvas

questions.question: What is a Tableau 'Story'?

options.text: A sequence of visualizations or dashboards that work together to convey information

questions.question: How does a Parameter differ from a Filter in Tableau?

questions.question: What is a common use case for Parameters in Tableau?

options.text: Letting users dynamically switch between different measures in a chart
Automatically connecting to a new database

questions.question: Which data types can a Tableau Parameter accept?

options.text: Integer, Float, String, Boolean, Date, and Date & Time

A way to hide a Parameter permanently

options.text: No, values must always be manually typed

questions.question: What is a Calculated Field in Tableau?

options.text: A field imported directly from the database with no modification
A new field created using a formula based on existing fields in the data source

questions.question: What is a Hierarchy in Tableau?

options.text: A ranked list of calculated fields

City

options.text: By dragging one field onto another in the Data pane to nest them
Automatically for every data source with no user action needed

What visual indicator appears in a view when a field with a Hierarchy is used, allowing users to drill

options.text: A plus (+) or minus (-) icon next to the field

options.text: It does not create any automatic hierarchies

options.text: Groups marks in a view into segments based on similarity across selected measures

options.text: No, the number of clusters is always fixed
